scope_binding.rule: This receipt covers only the exact 17-file set introduced by the 50->67 denominator correction; the prior 13 document-like root files and all child subtrees are excluded from credit.

files.name: .gitignore
files.finding: Defines repository/runtime boundary: excludes volatile DB WAL/SHM/journals, live DBs outside admitted reference/seed paths, secrets/tokens, generated user config, models, voices, ADI profiles, test/UI artifacts, node_modules and manual backup copies while explicitly preserving reference database/seed material.

files.name: install.sh
files.finding: Historical executable install topology: GPU auto-selection CPU/CUDA/Vulkan, separate main and ingestd venvs, llama.cpp and whisper.cpp builds, Qwen2.5-3B primary model plus optional Llama-3.1-8B, voice assets, and 39 systemd service/timer definitions. Newer source explicitly says Ollama removed and adaptive vision/OCR+YOLO used instead.

files.name: _bootstrap.py
files.finding: Minimal systemd/CLI import bootstrap inserts the AICORE source root at sys.path[0] so config.paths and sibling imports resolve regardless of invocation cwd.

files.name: install_wizard.py
files.finding: Rich terminal TUI wrapper around install.sh; supports source-tree and PyInstaller onefile execution, hardware checks/options, clone/install path resolution and progress parsing rather than defining an independent runtime architecture.

files.name: test_frank.py
files.finding: Not valid Python despite .py suffix; content is only 'Hello from Frank — build-script works!'. Treat as build marker/fixture, not executable test evidence.

files.name: .gitlab-ci.yml
files.finding: Local frank-local GitLab runner builds/pushes CPU image first then CUDA/Vulkan images sequentially to reduce OOM risk, with retry policy and main-branch gating.

files.name: Dockerfile
files.finding: Multi-stage Ubuntu 24.04 CPU/CUDA/Vulkan image compiles llama.cpp + whisper.cpp, creates frank user and persistent AICORE data/config/model paths, copies application and entrypoint, and exposes the core FRANK service port family.

files.name: .dockerignore
files.finding: Docker build context excludes VCS/cache/build artifacts, live runtime DB/WAL/SHM, logs, local env/config and orchestration files; confirms live state is intended to be rebuilt/mounted rather than baked into image.

files.name: docker-compose.vulkan.yml
files.finding: Vulkan override selects GPU_BACKEND=vulkan, GGML device 0, maps /dev/dri and video/render groups.

files.name: docker-compose.cuda.yml
files.finding: CUDA override selects NVIDIA CUDA 12.6 builder/runtime images and reserves one GPU via container runtime capabilities.

files.name: docker-compose.yml
files.finding: Base CPU FRANK container exposes 8088/8091/8093/8096/8097/8098/8099/8100/8101/8103/8105 and persists models, Frank data, Whisper models, voices and Kokoro via named volumes; memory limit 16G, reservation 4G.

files.name: titan.db
files.finding: Drive identity exists but raw payload is exactly zero bytes; no database contents exist to semantically mine in this artifact.

files.name: consciousness.db
files.finding: Drive identity exists but raw payload is exactly zero bytes; no consciousness-state database evidence is present in this root artifact.

files.name: install-wizard.spec
files.finding: PyInstaller specification bundles install_wizard.py, rich dependencies and install.sh into console executable frank-installer; packaging evidence only.

files.name: pyproject.toml
files.finding: Declares project-frankenstein 1.0.0, description F.R.A.N.K. Fully Realized Autonomous Neural Kernel, MIT license, Python >=3.10 and homepage/issues at gschaidergabriel/Project-Frankenstein; includes pytest/ruff policy.

files.name: config.yaml.example
files.finding: Documents paths, CPU/CUDA/Vulkan/ROCm selection, historical Ollama/LLaVA plus llama/qwen/whisper endpoints, microservice ports, overlay/voice and local-first privacy. This older Ollama vision configuration is superseded by the later install.sh statement that Ollama was removed for adaptive vision.

files.name: LICENSE
files.finding: MIT License artifact; legal/provenance metadata, not architecture evidence.

material_synthesis: The previously omitted root files encode deployment and runtime-boundary evidence, so the old document-only root view was semantically incomplete even though many architecture documents had already been read.

Historical deployment was explicitly multi-backend: CPU baseline plus CUDA and Vulkan variants, with llama.cpp/whisper.cpp compiled locally and persistent data/model/voice volumes separated from the image.
install.sh defines 39 systemd service/timer artifacts, showing a substantially broader live service topology than the small subset surfaced by docker-compose alone.

Repository and container ignore policies intentionally separate volatile/user/runtime state and secrets from source/reference data; this is relevant to current snapshot/recovery/UnifiedDB provenance design.

A source-version drift is resolved directionally: older config.yaml.example advertises Ollama/LLaVA vision, while later install.sh explicitly removes Ollama and names adaptive vision with OCR+YOLO; do not merge both as simultaneous current architecture.
test_frank.py is negative evidence against trusting filename extensions as executable-test proof; acceptance evidence must distinguish fixture markers from parsed/executed tests.
The root titan.db and consciousness.db files contribute identity only, not database semantic content, because both are exactly zero bytes.
